prompts.bun_base: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Single raw surveillance-camera frame for a synthetic rotating hotpot restaurant dataset. NOT a product photo, NOT overhead, NOT food photography. Fixed small cheap camera mounted on outer side of the conveyor ONLY about 15cm above plate level, looking across belt at a LOW oblique angle roughly 20 degrees above horizontal. The target plate is a strongly foreshortened wide ellipse: its front rim hides the bottom of food, rear food overlaps front food. Entire target plate occupies only about 45% of frame width, in the lower middle of a WIDE landscape frame. Show messy ordinary hotpot restaurant context: stainless conveyor slats diagonally receding across frame, edges of neighboring plates at left and right, distant dark red booth upholstery, metal rails, indistinct clutter and bowls in background. Neighbor plates should NOT contain the same target food. Cheap CCTV image appearance: low effective resolution, visible moderate compression artifacts, sensor noise in shadow, mild but noticeable conveyor motion blur across plate, uneven warm ceiling lighting mixed with cool reflections, slight underexposure. It must look like an imperfect incidental video capture, no shallow depth-of-field beauty bokeh. Do not add CCTV text overlays, timestamps, arrows, labels, brand logos or watermarks. Landscape 1536x1024. Target food: exactly eight small white steamed mantou buns on one ordinary white round ceramic plate, physically arranged two rows of four but viewed from the LOW SIDE so back-row buns are partly hidden behind the front row. Buns ordinary slightly irregular, not perfectly showroom arranged. Camera still allows approximate dish recognition but precise back-row count is harder due to occlusion. Some left-edge neighboring plate contains faint orange cakes. No hands obscuring the main target yet.
